tagline.en: The Foothill Freeway, at the base of the San Gabriel Mountains
tagline.zh: 山麓高速：沿圣盖博山脚而行

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

start.zh: 洛杉矶锡尔马，与 I-5 相接

end.en: Continues east as State Route 210 towards San Bernardino
end.zh: 向东以州道 210 号继续通往圣贝纳迪诺

en: I-210 runs along the foot of the San Gabriel Mountains, leaving I-5 at Sylmar in the northern San Fernando Valley and heading east through Pasadena, Arcadia, Azusa and San Dimas. It is the northernmost east–west route across the Los Angeles basin and the one drivers use to avoid I-10 and SR 60 further south. The federal log counts 44.68 miles because the Interstate designation stops short of the road's actual eastern end: beyond it the same freeway carries on as State Route 210.

The even hundreds digit says loop, and it is one in the loose sense — it leaves I-5 and the parent route is never far away — but the eastern end runs on into the Inland Empire rather than curving back. The mountain backdrop is the point of the road: it is routed along the alluvial fans below the range, which is why it stays out of the older, denser grid to the south.
zh: I-210 沿圣盖博山脚而行，自圣费尔南多谷北部的锡尔马离开 I-5，向东经帕萨迪纳、阿卡迪亚、阿苏萨与圣迪马斯。它是横穿洛杉矶盆地最靠北的一条东西向路线，司机们用它来避开南边的 I-10 与 SR 60。联邦路线名录只记 44.68 英里，是因为州际编号并未延伸到这条路实际的东端：再往东，同一条高速改以州道 210 号继续。
偶数百位意味着环线，宽泛地说它也确实是——它从 I-5 出发，母线始终不远——但东端是继续伸进内陆帝国，而不是折回。山的背景正是这条路的用意：它沿山前冲积扇布线，因而避开了南边更老、更密的城市路网。

en: Planning for the Foothill Freeway began in 1948, and the Los Angeles County portion was built through the 1960s and 1970s. What took the rest of the century was the extension east into San Bernardino County, which sat unbuilt for decades for want of money while other projects took priority.

The 28-mile extension from La Verne to San Bernardino was eventually costed at about $1.1 billion, paid for in large part by a county sales tax, and state officials at the 2001 dedication described it as the last major urban freeway project on California's books. The first 20 miles, from La Verne to Fontana, opened in November 2002. The final 7.25 miles, from Alder Avenue in Rialto to the interchange in San Bernardino, cost about $233 million, took four years to build and opened on 24 July 2007.
zh: 山麓高速的规划始于 1948 年，洛杉矶县境内路段在 1960 至 1970 年代建成。耗掉整个世纪余下时间的，是向东进入圣贝纳迪诺县的延伸段：它因缺乏资金、又被其他项目排在前面，几十年未能开工。
从拉韦恩到圣贝纳迪诺的 28 英里延伸段最终造价约 11 亿美元，主要由县级销售税支付；在 2001 年的通车仪式上，州交通官员称它是加州账上最后一个大型城市高速项目。前 20 英里自拉韦恩至丰塔纳，于 2002 年 11 月通车。最后 7.25 英里自里亚尔托的奥尔德大道至圣贝纳迪诺的枢纽，造价约 2.33 亿美元，建设四年，于 2007 年 7 月 24 日通车。

timeline.en: Planning begins for a freeway along the foot of the San Gabriel Mountains.
timeline.zh: 沿圣盖博山脚修建高速公路的规划启动。

timeline.en: The first 20 miles of the eastern extension open between La Verne and Fontana.
timeline.zh: 东延段前 20 英里在拉韦恩与丰塔纳之间通车。

timeline.en: The last 7.25 miles open, completing a road first planned 59 years earlier.
timeline.zh: 最后 7.25 英里通车，这条路最初的规划已是 59 年前。
